Node A's federation credential presented for Node B's Core route was rejected (401)
Node B's management address returned 401 to anonymous callers, to Node A's operator session and to a member bearer token on status, users, invitations, settings and updates
Node B's member listener returned 404 for management status; its management listener returned 404 for member login; health remained available only on the member listener
